detailed_description: Stable Diffusion Prompt Generator - Build a copy-ready prompt block from subject, style, details, lighting, aspect ratio, and negative prompt terms. The output separates positive prompt, negative prompt, and setting notes, including reminders to start with model defaults, tune steps and CFG after a preview, and keep the seed fixed when comparing prompt changes.
usage_steps: Enter the subject, style, visual details, and lighting direction
Choose an aspect ratio and edit the negative prompt terms
Review the positive prompt, negative prompt, and setting notes
Copy the block into your own Stable Diffusion workflow and refine after testing
usage_examples: Create a clean product-style image prompt with a matching negative prompt
Prepare a prompt note that keeps seed fixed while comparing changes
Switch aspect ratios before testing the same concept in another composition

faqs.question: Is the Stable Diffusion Prompt Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The generator runs in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does this generate images?
faqs.answer: No. It generates prompt text and setting notes only. Use the copied output in your own image generation setup.

faqs.question: Why are setting notes included?
faqs.answer: They give a short reminder for controlled prompt testing, such as starting with model defaults and keeping seed fixed when comparing changes.
